programs.description: Tori and Kyle find a baby boy in a spaceship and adopt him as their own child, Brandon. However, after turning 12, Brandon learns that he has superpowers and begins to use them for sinister purposes.
When his sister Annie gets trapped in a crevice atop K2 along with her crew, mountain climber Peter Garrett must assemble a team to rescue them before they perish.
Robert McCall gives up violence and wishes to lead a quiet life. However, brutal events force him to take up the fight for justice once again.
When Peter Venkman, Raymond Stantz and Egon Spengler lose their jobs as scientists, they start an establishment called Ghostbusters to fight the evil ghosts lurking in New York City.
Ladybug, a professional assassin, is assigned to retrieve a briefcase from a bullet train. Soon, he finds himself battling many other killers who board the same train but with a different objective.
A recruiter from New York gets a man recruited at a company and soon, they become friends. However, things get confusing when sex is involved in their relationship.
Josh Lambert and his family relocate to his mother's old house in the hopes of recovering from past trauma. However, they soon encounter strange and chilling paranormal events.
Keda, the young son of a tribe chief, is accidentally left behind and must survive in the wilderness. He then encounters an injured wolf abandoned by its pack and the two form a bond.
Judgement Day has occurred and Skynet has all but exterminated modern society. Now John Connor leads the resistance against Skynet but is unsure of victory until he encounters Marcus Wright.
A group of co-workers embark on a team-building exercise on an uninhabited island. However, when their ex-marine guide is killed, they are left stranded and must struggle to survive.
Sonny and Sam find an ancient manuscript in an abandoned house while cleaning it. However, things escalate when the text brings a ventriloquist dummy named Slappy to life.

programs.showName: You Don't Mess With the Zohan
programs.description: Zohan, an Israeli anti-terrorist commando, stages his own death when he gets tired of his job and goes to New York City to follow his dream of being a hairstylist.
Captain Artemis and her group of soldiers are pulled into a world where dangerous monsters and humans co-exist. Grappled by danger, they must find a way to escape with help from a mysterious hunter.
John Connor, a cybernetic warrior from the future, travels back in time to accomplish his mission of protecting a man and his future wife, Kate, from a robotic attack.
Peter Parker, the beloved superhero Spider-Man, faces four destructive elemental monsters while on holiday in Europe. Soon, he receives help from Mysterio, a fellow hero with mysterious origins.

As WWII comes to an end, Aatami Korpi trudges towards retirement with a bag full of gold. However, when a Nazi soldier learns about the treasure, he chases after the warrior, unaware of his prowess.
Four fighters from different backgrounds come together to train under a former MMA star. Ultimately, they have to fight each other and also the traitor who hides among them.
During a babysitting job, Jill, a young woman, is terrorised by a psychopathic killer's ominous calls. Years later, he returns to menace her once again.
Miles befriends A-X-L, a robotic dog, when he manages to activate its owner-pairing technology. However, Miles's life takes an unusual turn when A-X-L's creators come searching for it.
The Angels track down rings containing the names of those in the FBI's witness protection programme. However, the witnesses begin to get murdered one by one.

programs.showName: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
programs.description: A diligent scientist invents an innovative machine that drops food from the sky to help his fellow residents. Chaos ensues when the machine becomes uncontrollable.
Harold's drawings spring to life when he ventures into the real world. His purple crayon accidentally creates challenges and he and his friends must safeguard both worlds.
When Van Helsing's invention goes awry, Johnny turns into a monster and Dracula becomes human. Later, they embark on a journey to find a cure before their transformations become permanent.
Old-school cops Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett team up with the Miami PD's newly-created elite team to take down the vicious leader of a drug cartel.
A hard-living superhero who has fallen out of favor with the public enters into a questionable relationship with the wife of the public relations professional who's trying to repair his image.
A father-son duo crash-land on Earth, a millennium after an accident forced humans to evacuate the planet. With the father grievously injured, the son must put his life on the line to secure help.
Agent J of the Men in Black goes back in time to prevent the assassination of his partner, Agent K, at the hands of an alien criminal named Boris the Animal.
Tired of Chris's professional failures, his wife decides to separate, leaving him financially broke with an unpaid internship in a brokerage firm and his son's custody to deal with.
Mike and Marcus face their toughest case yet as their late captain's reputation hangs in the balance. Subsequently, they unravel a complex web of cartel connections in a high-stakes mission.
A professional dating expert helps men woo the women of their dreams. However, while helping a hapless client, he finds himself challenged by a gossip columnist.

Two associates of an elite commando team fight an army of zombies controlled by an evil desktop computer in a genetic research facility.
After a mysterious virus wreaks havoc in the United Kingdom, a team of survivors tries to cope with the aftermath of the disaster and find security.
Parapsychologist Elise Rainier gets thrust into returning to her eerie childhood home where she and her family have to fight a dangerous otherworldly entity.
Three delinquents break into the house of Norman, a Gulf War veteran who is visually impaired, to steal his money. However, they discover that Norman is not as helpless as he seems.
A genetically modified anaconda and a giant crocodile escape captivity and enter a nearby lake. When the two massive creatures fight, the sheriff tries to prevent the town from being destroyed.
Former martial arts titleholder prepares to return to familiar fields and uses his traditional fighting skills against the new line of fighters in order to reclaim his position.
Motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze gives up his soul to save his father and becomes the Ghost Rider to fight against Blackheart, the son of Mephistopheles, the devil himself.
Tintin's new model ship sparks an adventure of intrigue and theft. He uncovers a historical mystery involving treasure, rival groups and a quest for scrolls revealing a sunken ship's location.
K, an officer with the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a secret that could create chaos. He goes in search of a former Blade Runner who has been missing for over three decades.
After Spencer goes missing, his team of confidantes comes back to Jumanji to go to the undiscovered regions and support him in escaping the world's most lethal game.
Miles Morales travels the spider-verse and meets a league of spider-people as he fights a new enemy, the Spot. But upon trying to change his canon event, he is pitted against the other Spider-Men.
With the help of a mechanic having a tragic past, an avid player of racing video games attempts to become a professional car racer.
Hellboy is a demonic warrior who protects the Earth from paranormal threats. When an enemy from his past makes a comeback, it is up to him and his team to stop the villain once and for all.
After a girl with hearing impairment envisions the Virgin Mary and regains her ability to hear along with other powers, a journalist unravels the truth behind this paranoia.

Michael Nantz, a Marine staff sergeant, renders his services again, soon after his retirement. He and his platoon have to save the city of Los Angeles from alien invaders.
When their involvement with the wrong people puts her and her family at risk, Ashley turns to her estranged father for help, who is living a retired life in the Cayman Islands.
Ty Hackett takes up a job in the same company where his father worked before he died. His mentor Mike convinces him to be a part of the robbery of two armoured trucks, but their plan goes haywire.
A widower embarks on an emotional journey while raising his daughter single-handedly despite encountering several hurdles along the way.
Louis, an Interpol agent, and Eleanor, a district attorney, learn that their lives at risk after they team up to track the money that a bank is using to fund terrorism.
A group of friends find themselves running for their very lives from Ray Sawyer, a reanimated corpse possessed by 13 evil souls, who has vicious plans for them.
Recruited by Victor, street-smart Nathan steps into a race for the lost treasure of Ferdinand Magellan. However, a corrupt billionaire and an evil mercenary also have the same goal.
A single mother and her two children move into a farmhouse inherited from her estranged father. As they settle in, they discover their associations with Ghostbusters.
Prepped to be the successor of his father's drug empire, a near-death experience alters Sergei's physicality. Sergei now treads the path of vengeance as he hunts criminals.
Tori and Kyle find a baby boy in a spaceship and adopt him as their own child, Brandon. However, after turning 12, Brandon learns that he has superpowers and begins to use them for sinister purposes.
A young and ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between a seemingly perfect match and her imperfect ex-boyfriend.
Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita and Little Rock set out on a mission to protect the rest of humanity by fighting evolved zombies while also battling their own internal demons.
A symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, intensifying his abilities and aggression. Now, he must face the challenges that his new powers bring while simultaneously fighting new villains.
Ben and Zoey find themselves trapped in a series of deadly escape rooms with four others. They try to survive and find a way out as they slowly discover that they have played the game before.

CIA agent Evelyn Salt's life takes an ugly turn when she is accused of planning the assassination of the Russian president. However, she flees and sets out to prove her innocence.
When Gargamel learns that Smurfette knows a secret spell that can turn Naughties, Smurf-like creatures, into real Smurfs, he kidnaps her. The Smurfs set out to rescue Smurfette.

Father Gabriele Amorth, an exorcist, uncovers a hidden conspiracy as he investigates the horrifying possession of a young boy.

Young Angus Mac Morrow discovers a mysterious egg that grows up to be the Loch Ness monster. As they form a strong relationship, the boy's family refuses to believe in the creature's existence.
Peter Parker tries to stop the Vulture from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.
